subject.title: fix: recover updater from late launchd bootout errors

question: Should the canonical launchd stop-proof retry land from this focused PR, with the sibling PR reduced to its distinct plist repair?
rationale: Both open branches change the same availability-sensitive updater transition with different retry windows, and repository evidence cannot safely allow both policies to land independently.

options.title: Land the focused retry
options.body: Refresh and land this narrower authoritative-proof implementation, then remove the duplicate retry from the sibling and preserve only its distinct plist repair.

options.title: Consolidate into one replacement
options.body: Create one clean branch containing the preferred retry semantics plus the wrapped-LaunchAgent plist repair, with focused tests and managed-macOS validation.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep both PRs unmerged until the retry duration and canonical ownership are explicitly selected.

recommendation.title: Land the focused retry
recommendation.body: Refresh and land this narrower authoritative-proof implementation, then remove the duplicate retry from the sibling and preserve only its distinct plist repair.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the affected updater flow and owns both competing implementations and their live reproduction context.
